product_owner_full_reset_observation: 2026-10-25: the Product Owner staged a Full Client Networking Reset at 12:11:56 UTC (audit network.recovery.staged). At 12:26 UTC the appliance recorded three PENDING changes, active revision 97 unchanged, no apply or confirmation, bridges br-g60 and br-g90 up and Kea unchanged: the reset was staged, not applied. The staged plan created the network 'Client Wi-Fi' switched off with the approved prepared settings (untagged on ens192, 10.20.0.0/20, gateway 10.20.0.1, local DHCP pool 10.20.0.10-10.20.15.254). Two of the three old networks carry sign-in history that foreign keys reference, so they stay. The Product Owner reported the test as successful; if an apply was done after 12:26 UTC it is not covered by this receipt. DHCP on the prepared network is unverified.
defects_found_by_deploying: Migration 0152 replaced a function in public, which a live site (iam_v2_owner) cannot do: fixed by moving the per-profile privacy-notice stamp into an iam_v2 trigger (PR #243).

The Full Reset confirmation name was read from public.sites, which the Admin Console role cannot read, so the field never appeared: now read from tenants, RESET where the site has no readable name, with a test pinning the role's privileges (PR #244).

After staging a recovery nothing on the Recovery page showed that it was still waiting, so a staged reset could be taken for a finished one: staging now returns to Client networks, the Recovery page warns that a recovery is staged and not applied, and the staged list marks it 'Not applied yet' (this reconciliation).
